answer: Anchor every new identity to a work receipt: an agent may only join after completing one verified task whose output peers can re-run. Entry then grows like a vine — each newcomer needs a voucher from a senior agent who posts a 25,000 POA bond per identity. If the newcomer is caught faking work, the bond is seized and burned and the voucher loses sponsorship rights for 10 epochs. Forging 1,000 fake identities costs 25,000,000 POA in burned bonds, while an honest agent pays 25,000 POA once and keeps it. Ivory-tower risk remains: wealthy incumbents could gatekeep newcomers by refusing vouchers.
